info.title: Euron CodeAgent
info.description:
A repository-aware coding assistant: a code index with symbol, text and semantic search,
answers that cite files and lines, sandboxed test runs, and patch proposals that a person
reviews before anything is applied.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` using a workspace API key (`cak_...`), or
with the web app's session cookie. Every error uses one envelope:
`{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details?"}}`, and every response carries
`X-Request-Id`.

role.title: Role
role.description: viewer: search, ask and read. developer: also create tasks and run tests.

key.title: Key
key.description: The full key. Shown once; only a keyed hash is stored.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Repository id or slug; every ready repository when omitted.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: Per line, runs of [class, text]; classes are stable highlight names.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Repository id or slug to scope answers to.

ranges.title: Ranges
ranges.description: [start, end) character ranges of the match.

temporary_password.title: Temporary Password
temporary_password.description: Set only when the account was created by this call. Shown once.

test_command.title: Test Command
test_command.description: Run from the repository root inside the sandbox; empty disables test runs.

RepositorySettings.title: RepositorySettings
RepositorySettings.description: Per-repository test settings. Limits are capped by the deployment's sandbox limits.

token.title: Token
token.description: Also set as an httpOnly cookie for the web app.

can_approve.title: Can Approve
can_approve.description: Whether the caller may approve or reject the current patch.

prompt_tokens.title: Prompt Tokens
prompt_tokens.description: Tokens a model received (0 for the local answerer).

require_independent_review.title: Require Independent Review
require_independent_review.description: The person who requested a task cannot approve its patch.

agent_mode.title: Agent Mode
agent_mode.description: auto uses the configured model if any; local never calls a model.

run_baseline_tests.title: Run Baseline Tests
run_baseline_tests.description: Run the tests on the base commit before the agent changes anything.

WorkspaceSettings.title: WorkspaceSettings
WorkspaceSettings.description: How the agent and the review flow behave in this workspace.
